project.title: Full-scale multi-stage anoxic-oxic A/O system treating food waste digestate: 16S rRNA gene V4 amplicon sequencing of activated sludge from reactors A1, O1, O2, O3 and A2
project.description: This BioProject contains 16S rRNA gene V4 amplicon sequencing data from activated sludge sampled in a full-scale multi-stage anoxic-oxic (A/O) biological treatment system treating food waste digestate (FWD) in Nanjing, Jiangsu, China. The system consists of five rectangular reactors connected in series, A1 (pre-anoxic), O1, O2 and O3 (aerobic) and A2 (post-anoxic), followed by a membrane bioreactor for solid-liquid separation. Mixed liquor samples were collected from the five reactors and the V4 hypervariable region of the 16S rRNA gene was amplified with primers 515F (GTGCCAGCMGCCGCGGTAA) and 806R (GGACTACHVGGGTWTCTAAT) and sequenced paired-end on the DNBSEQ-G99 platform. The data were used to characterise the spatial differentiation of the microbial community along the treatment train and to support the interpretation of nitrogen-transformation and carbon-utilisation processes reported in the associated manuscript.
